expectations.text: Creates a dataspec/ directory with platform.yaml
expectations.evidence: platform.yaml exists in outputs/dataspec/ with storage backends and engines defined

expectations.text: platform.yaml defines at least one storage backend (s3 or clickhouse)
expectations.evidence: platform.yaml defines s3-data-lake (s3) and clickhouse-analytics (clickhouse) storage backends

expectations.text: platform.yaml defines at least one engine (dbt)
expectations.evidence: platform.yaml defines dbt-transforms (dbt) and spark-processing (spark) engines

expectations.text: Creates source files for the PostgreSQL database
expectations.evidence: sources/postgresql_db.yaml exists with type 'database' and entities for transactions, merchants, payouts

expectations.text: Creates contract files with proper field types (uuid, string, integer, timestamp)
expectations.evidence: 9 contract files created with proper types: uuid for IDs, string for names, integer for amounts, timestamp for dates

expectations.text: Creates dataset files that reference storage backends from platform.yaml
expectations.evidence: 8 dataset files created, all reference 's3-data-lake' or 'clickhouse-analytics' backends from platform.yaml

expectations.text: Creates at least one flow file with extract, transform, and load steps
expectations.evidence: 4 flow files created: transaction_etl_pipeline, merchant_etl_pipeline, payout_etl_pipeline, unified_analytics_pipeline - all contain extract/transform/load steps

expectations.text: All cross-references between resources are valid (source names, contract names, dataset names, engine names)
expectations.evidence: Verified: flows reference 'postgresql_db' source, contracts use correct names in datasets, datasets reference valid storage backends

expectations.text: The skill correctly reads reference files to understand syntax
expectations.evidence: Subagent log shows reading of platform.md, source.md, contract.md, dataset.md, flow.md references from skill directory
